# RemoteJobs44

> RemoteJobs44 is a remote job board focused on African job seekers (Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana, Egypt, Morocco, Rwanda, Uganda) with 50,000+ verified remote jobs from global companies. AI-powered CV review and interview prep included.

## What is RemoteJobs44?

RemoteJobs44 (https://remotejobs44.com) is a subscription-based remote job board built for African talent applying to global companies. Free users browse jobs; paid plans unlock direct apply links, application tracking, AI CV review, and AI interview prep. Jobs are aggregated from Remotive, RemoteOK, Arbeitnow, Working Nomads, Himalayas, Jobicy, plus direct Greenhouse / Lever / Ashby / Workable ATS feeds and SerpApi-backed Google Jobs.

## Plans

- **Free**: Browse all 50,000+ jobs, save favourites
- **Day Pass**: 24-hour full access, 10 applications — ₦500
- **Pro Monthly**: Unlimited applications, alerts, AI tools — ₦2,999 / month
- **Pro Annual**: Same as Pro Monthly, billed yearly — ₦29,999 / year (saves ₦5,989)

## Key features

- 50,000+ remote jobs from 8+ aggregators and direct ATS feeds, refreshed every 6 hours
- Application tracker (Slack-style status board)
- **AI CV review** — paste your CV, get a 0–100 score, strengths, gaps, ATS keywords missing, and rewrite tips (uses the AI provider an admin enables in /admin/ai-discovery)
- **AI interview prep** — type a role + level, get behavioural / technical / remote-specific questions with answer skeletons and red-flag mistakes
- Filter by category, job type, experience level, salary, country, region, timezone, skill
- Category landing pages: /jobs/category/{engineering,design,marketing,finance,sales,data,hr,product,legal,operations}
- Country landing pages: /jobs/country/{nigeria,kenya,south-africa,ghana,egypt,morocco,rwanda,uganda,india,philippines,pakistan,brazil,mexico,argentina,worldwide}
- Skill landing pages: /jobs/skill/{react,typescript,node,python,django,rails,go,rust,java,kotlin,swift,flutter,react-native,devops,aws,kubernetes,terraform,sql,postgres,figma,seo,content,copywriting,sales-dev}
- Timezone landing pages: /jobs/timezone/{wat,eat,sast,gmt,cet,est,pst}
- Region landing pages: /jobs/region/{africa,europe,americas,asia,middle-east,worldwide}

## Who is it for?

Remote workers in Africa (especially Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ghana, Egypt, Morocco, Rwanda, Uganda) applying to global companies. Categories well-served: software engineering, product design, product management, marketing, content, customer success, sales development, data analytics. Levels: entry, mid, senior, lead, executive.
